verdict.rationale: Veriff emits events through decision, event, watchlist-screening and user-defined-status webhooks, sent immediately after decisions. Automated actions based on verification decisions are available through the no-code Zapier integration, so rule-based automation exists but depends on Zapier or the customer's own webhook handlers rather than a native rules engine. Missing for 10: native in-product rule/trigger definition, documented conditional logic or action configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
